# Cleaning Mistral Edibles
```{python}
df['Mistral_edibles'] = df['Mistral_edibles'].str.replace('\n','').str.strip()
df['Mistral_edibles']
```

# Final cleaning of edibles (turning it into a list)
```{python}
import ast
df['Mistral_edibles'] = df['Mistral_edibles'].str.replace('[','')
df['Mistral_edibles'] = df['Mistral_edibles'].str.replace(']','')

df['test'] = df['Mistral_edibles']
df['test'] = df['test'].str.replace("'","").str.strip().str.split(",")
# df['test'] = df['test'].map(lambda x: ast.literal_eval(f"[{x}]"))

df['test']
```
